ABOUT THIS ESTIMATE

Local equations. Clear limits.

Version 1 includes 52 numerically reconciled tables for selected locations in Malakand and Hazara. Each included table reproduces its printed height and volume values, has a documented sample range, and has no unresolved calculation conflict after checking the available sources. Original formula workbooks resolve copying and coefficient differences in several summary tables. Numerical agreement is not independent field validation or departmental approval.

Equation and source details

Source: Pakistan Forest Institute, Malakand and Hazara local volume tables and companion comparison and original formula workbooks, supplied September 2026. Calculator version: 1.1. Equation set: 1.

DBH is not rounded before calculation. Printed whole-inch table labels can represent rounded centimetre-based diameters, so a printed table lookup may differ from an exact-inch calculation.

Coverage and measurement limits

Coverage is limited to the listed species–location combinations. Select a named local table when it applies. A general division table is separately identified; an unavailable local table is not automatically replaced. Balakot Forest in Kalam and Balakot Sub-Division in Kaghan are separate locations.

Results are limited to each table’s documented sample DBH range. Non-positive model estimates are not reported. Fir/spruce options retain the source’s combined table; they are not separate species models.

The source tables describe healthy, well-formed dominant or co-dominant trees. Bark basis, stem condition and local applicability matter when using an estimate.

Version history

Version 1.1
Offline preparation, device-local inventories, survey details, Excel/CSV import and exports, backups and printable inventory reports. Equation set 1 is unchanged.

Version 1 · September 2026
Expanded release with 52 reconciled local tables, region and division selection, documented diameter limits and PFI identification. Supersedes the initial five-table pilot.

Additional species and locations will be introduced in later versions after their equations and source discrepancies are resolved. Printed results identify the calculator version and source table.
